figurative_meaning_en: Misfortune or ill fate, especially a mild curse directed at women implying no good fortune
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কপালে আগুন, যা করুক না কেন সব উল্টো হয়ে যায়।
মেয়েরা কখনো কখনো এই গালি শোনে যখন দুর্ভাগ্যের কথা বলা হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: She has fire on her forehead; whatever she does turns out wrong.
Women sometimes hear this mild curse when misfortune is mentioned.
history: Referenced in the poetry of Ishwar Gupta, a 19th-century Bengali poet, in the line 'কোন গুণ নেই তার কপালে আগুন' to denote lack of virtue and misfortune.
note: Primarily used in literary or poetic contexts, with a gendered connotation towards women.
